content:
Here is the English translation of the Ancient Greek text:

Then the lord of men, Agamemnon, spoke to him in turn:
"I rejoice, son of Laertes, hearing your words,
for you have gone through and set out all things fittingly.
These things I wish to swear to, and my heart urges me,
nor will I swear falsely before the god. But let Achilles
wait here for now, eager as he is for battle;
and let all the rest of you wait together, until the gifts
come from my hut and we cut the faithful oaths.
And to you yourself I give this charge and command:
select the best young men of all the Achaeans
to bring the gifts from my ship, all those which
yesterday we promised to give to Achilles, and bring the women.
And let Talthybius swiftly throughout the broad army of the Achaeans
make ready a boar to be slaughtered for Zeus and the Sun."
